download_realunify_ueg_dataset: download the RealUnify UEG dataset from HuggingFace and save prompts to a JSONL file
load_prompts_from_directory: load all RealUnify UEG prompts from a data directory into a lookup dictionary by ID
get_prompt_by_id: get a specific RealUnify UEG prompt by its ID like UEG_60_world_knowledge from the data directory
review_download_function: review the download function to understand how it fetches and processes the UEG_direct.json dataset
refactor_load_prompts: refactor the load_prompts function to support filtering prompts by task_type metadata field
